_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

title.description: Title of the CAPA; used as its display value in other collections

customerComplaintName.description: Display value of customerComplaintId, copied from u_mes_qual_customerComplaint.description

auditName.description: Display value of auditId, copied from u_mes_qual_audit.title

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

customerName.description: Display value of customerId, copied from u_mes_mast_customer.name

openedAt.description: Date and time when the record was opened. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

openedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'opened'

openedBy.description: Display name of the user in openedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

d7PreventionPfmeaId.description: Reference to u_mes_qual_pfmea._id: D7 prevention PFMEA

d7PreventionPfmeaName.description: Display value of d7PreventionPfmeaId, copied from u_mes_qual_pfmea.title

d7PreventionControlPlanId.description: Reference to u_mes_qual_controlPlan._id: D7 prevention control plan

d7PreventionControlPlanName.description: Display value of d7PreventionControlPlanId, copied from u_mes_qual_controlPlan.recordNo

d8ClosureClosedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'D8 closure closed'

d8ClosureClosedBy.description: Display name of the user in d8ClosureClosedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

d8ClosureClosedAt.description: D8 closure closed date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

d8ClosureCustomerAccepted.description: True when: D8 closure customer accepted

dueAt.description: Due date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
